effectiveness_condition: Independent precommit review; separate D0349 commit; independent postcommit review; separate GitHub push; independent exact refs/heads/main SHA readback.

six_explicit_successor_governance_decisi.effect_if_independently_approved_and_eff: Permits only separately staged corrected implementation authoring and independent static review within the explicit F1/F2 correction scope. It does not itself permit corrected freeze publication, readiness, synthetic execution or ZE2 execution.
six_explicit_successor_governance_decisi.proposed_resolution: D0349 is a new, non-retroactive prospective authorization candidate. It becomes effective only after independent precommit review, separate local commit, independent postcommit review, non-forced GitHub publication, and separate exact remote readback verifying the resulting D0349 commit SHA on refs/heads/main. The effective SHA cannot be predetermined.

six_explicit_successor_governance_decisi.effect_if_independently_approved_and_eff: Allows a future freeze eligibility review against this new ancestry rule, but does not itself authorize a freeze commit or its publication.
six_explicit_successor_governance_decisi.proposed_resolution: The prospective corrected implementation freeze must have the independently verified effective D0349 commit as its exact direct parent, and must preserve the D0345-D0346-D0347-D0348-D0349 ancestry. This is a narrowly scoped prospective successor to the original D0345 direct-parent requirement, not a retroactive alteration of D0345 or D0346. Any intervening commit requires a separate reviewed and effective governance amendment.

six_explicit_successor_governance_decisi.effect_if_independently_approved_and_eff: Establishes the proposed handoff contract only; does not perform a handoff, grant a second attempt or make the existing attempt exercisable.
six_explicit_successor_governance_decisi.proposed_resolution: The original remaining readiness attempt stays unconsumed and non-exercisable. No additional attempt is created. Any later exclusive rebind to the corrected freeze requires a separately effective pre-readiness safety disposition after corrected freeze publication, new preflight, independent receipt review and proof that no competing D0346/D0345 readiness route remains executable. The rebind and any one-shot consumption must be recorded atomically at the authorized readiness boundary under a unique successor identity.

six_explicit_successor_governance_decisi.effect_if_independently_approved_and_eff: Defines the required new receipt binding and review contract; does not execute a preflight.
six_explicit_successor_governance_decisi.proposed_resolution: A future new non-consuming preflight must bind the exact corrected freeze commit SHA, its parent, corrected source SHA-256, authorization lineage, frozen runtime and Git hook identities, applicable readiness-check contract and non-consumption status. Its evidence must be independently reviewed before the readiness safety disposition. The historical D0346 receipt remains immutable and is never reused, renamed or overwritten.

six_explicit_successor_governance_decisi.effect_if_independently_approved_and_eff: Provides a bounded authoring scope only. Requires separate source review, approved freeze and later safety verification.
six_explicit_successor_governance_decisi.proposed_resolution: Preserve the identities and order of all fifteen D0345 readiness checks, D0343 F0-F6 regeneration, D0336 matching/output semantics and D0344 execution ordering. Allow source changes only to resolve D0347-F1 scoped subprocess pipe-FD handling and D0347-F2 positive/negative synthetic attestation coverage. Deny generic integer-FD exemptions, semantic relaxation and unrelated behavior changes.

six_explicit_successor_governance_decisi.effect_if_independently_approved_and_eff: Specifies verification prerequisites only; does not consume or activate either one-shot capacity.
six_explicit_successor_governance_decisi.proposed_resolution: Before any remaining readiness attempt can begin, require effective D0349 publication, independently reviewed corrected source, separately committed and published corrected freeze, exact remote readback, new non-consuming preflight, independent receipt review, explicit old-route exclusion and separate pre-readiness safety approval. Only the readiness transaction may run the frozen synthetic vectors or test the ZE2 reserved output root at its prescribed check. ZE2 scientific execution remains a later, separate authorization gate.
